value.name: Pneumonia
value.description: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs. The air sacs may fill with fluid or pus (purulent material), causing cough with phlegm or pus, fever, chills, and difficulty breathing. It can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
symptoms: Chest pain when you breathe or cough

value.name: Bronchitis
value.description: Bronchitis is an inflammation of the lining of your bronchial tubes, which carry air to and from your lungs. People who have bronchitis often cough up thickened mucus, which can be discolored. Bronchitis can be acute or chronic.
symptoms: Production of mucus (sputum), which can be clear, white, yellowish-white or greenish-brown

value.name: Asthma
value.description: Asthma is a chronic condition that causes the airways to become inflamed, narrow, and produce extra mucus. This can make it difficult to breathe and can trigger coughing, wheezing, and shortness of breath. Asthma attacks can be life-threatening.
symptoms: Trouble sleeping caused by shortness of breath, coughing or wheezing

value.name: Pleurisy
value.description: Pleurisy, also called pleuritis, is inflammation of the pleura, the membranes that line the lungs and the inside of the chest cavity. This inflammation causes sharp chest pain that worsens when you breathe, cough, or sneeze. It is often caused by infections or other underlying conditions.
symptoms: Pain that worsens with breathing, coughing, or sneezing

value.name: Lung Cancer
value.description: Lung cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the lungs. It occurs when cells in the lung start to grow out of control, forming tumors. These tumors can spread to other parts of the body. The most common symptom is a persistent cough.
symptoms: A new cough that doesn't go away
